fc.noSelection: First select grid points ("Grid points" tab) for at least one model.
fc.archiveHelp: Archives: GFS (AWS, since 2021) and IFS (AWS, since 2023). ICON: ~24 h only at DWD, hence automatic archiving.
fc.acceptPaid: I accept using a paid source for this request
fc.estimateTitle: Estimate per source (limit {{limit}} MB per model)
fc.noJobs: No download for this site yet.
fc.flagHelp: Step {{step}}: markers show the model's native lead times (or aggregates of a finer step); between markers, values are interpolated (U/V). Exports carry the time_flag column.
fc.chartDir: Direction at {{height}} (where the wind comes from)
fc.roseHelp: Native lead times only, all points and members: {{n}} values, mean speed {{mean}} m/s.
fc.needTwo: Download at least two models to compare them.
fc.comparisonHelp: 3 h step, mean of the selected points (and members for ensembles), {{n}} common times. MMM: multi-model mean (reference, not an observation).

ds.title: Data sources
ds.help: Paid sources stay disabled until an administrator enables them; each request must then accept them explicitly, and the choice is recorded.

arch.title: Automatic archiving
arch.help: Every hour, new runs of the ticked models are downloaded at the selected points of each site. Essential for ICON (DWD keeps ~24 h only) and for calibration (milestone 6).

farm.importTypeHelp: .wtg (WAsP) or CSV file (columns ws; power_kw; ct). Fill in what the file lacks; a dry run shows the checks before saving.
farm.importLayoutHelp: CSV/XLSX (columns id, x, y or lat, lon, type, hub_height, crs), KML or zipped Shapefile (with .prj). The default CRS applies to rows without a CRS.

mast.importHelp: Text formats: Campbell TOA5, NRG SymphoniePRO text export, Windographer export, generic CSV. The column mapping is suggested and editable.
mast.imported: Import done: {{n}} records read, {{gap}} missing inserted, {{dup}} duplicates removed.
mast.tzHelp: Everything is converted to UTC, interval-end timestamps. A civil (IANA) zone marks ambiguous DST instants as missing; prefer a fixed offset if the logger never changes time.
mast.qcHelp: Click a row to show that sensor. Flagged values are excluded from analyses; ws@h composites combine redundant anemometers outside tower shadow.
mast.seriesHelp: Crosses: values flagged by quality control.
mast.noShear: At least two speed heights are needed.
mast.noZ0: Download land cover (Terrain tab) to estimate z0.
mast.name: Mast name

terrain.sourcesHelp: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM (30 m) and ESA WorldCover 2021 land cover (10 m), downloaded over the extent of turbines, masts and sites, widened by the margin.
terrain.mapHelp: The .map format carries no coordinate system: pick the map's one. The map is displayed; it is not yet used in calculations.
terrain.name: Name
terrain.label: Label
